prompt.text:
Implement `prepareWorkshopRequest(input)`. `input` must be a non-null, non-array object or the function throws `TypeError`. Read string fields `title`, `summary`, `host`, `contactEmail`, and `secret`, plus a `topics` array of strings. Trim all strings. Required string fields and every topic must remain non-empty after trimming, and at least one topic is required. The email must have one `@`, non-empty text on both sides, and no whitespace. The secret must be at least eight Unicode code points and contain an ASCII uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, and one character that is not an ASCII letter or digit. Return `{ ok, errors, payload }`, where errors is an array in this order: required-field errors in field order, topics error, email format error, then secret-strength error. On success, payload is a new object with copied trimmed values and topics; otherwise payload is null. Do not mutate or alias the input or its topics array. Export exactly `{ prepareWorkshopRequest }` using `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
